artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent guidelines — project overview, TDD methodology, environment/tooling, the six-layer clearinghouse layout (framework / domain-legislative / usa-wa-common vocabulary / adapters / facts / deployment) enforced by import-linter, per-package module map, infrastructure and systemd topology, DB role split, env vars, commit and logging conventions, and the code exploration policy. Source of truth for how the repo is organized.

artifacts.name: architecture-pattern
artifacts.description: The reusable Layer-3 sourcing pattern — sourcing vs. application, multi-source target packages, the harvest.py (Phase A) / build.py (Phase B) split, and the two binding rules: audit a source's coverage before building on it, and never key a parser on an exact upstream string. Read before adding an adapter, a data source, or a span/seat builder.

artifacts.name: ontology
artifacts.description: The domain model — what ingested data becomes: entities, lifecycle axes, spans-as-assignments, and the three event shapes. Sibling of ARCHITECTURE.md (which covers how data gets in). Read before adding a fact.

artifacts.name: architecture-design
artifacts.description: The original MVP architecture design — the four-layer clearinghouse split (clearinghouse-core / domain-legislative / per-jurisdiction adapters / deployment API), provenance model, and adapter contract. Historical baseline: the layering has since grown to six layers (see AGENTS.md), but this remains the source of truth for the data model and the founding design decisions.

artifacts.name: architecture-specs
artifacts.description: Architecture specs — jurisdiction decoupling, identity sync, Power Map sync sidecar, WSL SOAP transformation, committee historical backfill, merge-orphan self-heal, subscription sync, and more. Source of truth for design decisions per subsystem.

artifacts.name: design-plans
artifacts.description: Per-phase implementation plans — foundation/discovery, hybrid legislative IA, jurisdiction decoupling, sync sidecar, outbox dead-letter, entity-event wiring, WSL adapter phases, and later backlog. Historical record of how each phase was built.

artifacts.name: integration-contracts
artifacts.description: Discovery outputs and integration contracts — Archiver/Watcher/Power Map contracts, multi-state legislative IA delta, jurisdictional information architecture, and Power Map reseed guidance.

artifacts.name: modules-framework
artifacts.description: Layers 1-2 module reference — the jurisdiction-agnostic framework primitives in clearinghouse-core and the legislative domain model in clearinghouse-domain-legislative, including the term calendar, the span engine, and the CohortProvider Protocols.

artifacts.name: modules-sync-engine
artifacts.description: The portable Power Map sync engine and the generated PM client — producer descriptors, the write path, and the engine seam shared across deployments.

artifacts.name: modules-common
artifacts.description: Layer 2b usa-wa-common module reference — Washington vocabulary (term calendar, seats, name handling, parties, ballot) and the cohort seam. Source-free: may not import an adapter.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature
artifacts.description: WSL (Washington State Legislature) adapter module reference — SOAP transport, normalizers, the daily refresh path, cohort providers, and write-free probes. The ingest half of the usa-wa-adapter-legislature package.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature-roster
artifacts.description: The roster-PDF source (1889-2025 official member roster) — parser, audit oracle, and the succession → resolve → backfill pipeline that adds ~102 years of member coverage with exact succession dates.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature-spans
artifacts.description: The tenure-span subject area across two layers — the Layer-2 engine (biennium arithmetic, merged-span builder, span→Assignment emitter, operator succession overlay) and the Layer-3 WSL drivers (operator-event store, roster hygiene, Phase-B span builders, span-collapse migrations).

artifacts.name: modules-pdc
artifacts.description: PDC (Public Disclosure Commission) SODA adapter module reference — identifier-only sourcing.

artifacts.name: modules-sos
artifacts.description: Washington Secretary of State adapter module reference — the filings and election-results sources.

artifacts.name: modules-facts-seats
artifacts.description: Layer 3b usa-wa-facts-seats module reference — the composition layer that builds cohorts across adapters: House Position, Senate corroboration, and PDC spans.

artifacts.name: modules-sync
artifacts.description: Layer 4 module reference — the usa-wa-api deployment, the Power Map sidecar daemon, and the repo-root directories.

artifacts.name: modules-sync-producers
artifacts.description: The one-shot Power Map producer CLIs — reconcilers, heals, validation, and retraction.

artifacts.name: commands
artifacts.description: Command index plus setup, tests, migrations, and the daily refresh — the entry point to the grouped operational and backfill command references.

artifacts.name: commands-succession
artifacts.description: Operator succession commands — odd-year corroboration and committee lineage.

artifacts.name: commands-sync
artifacts.description: Power Map sync commands — reconcilers, heals, validation, provenance and integrity sweeps.

artifacts.name: commands-backfill
artifacts.description: Backfill commands — historical harvests, span builders, one-shot migrations, and write-free probes. Pair with USA_WA_BIENNIUM to target a non-current biennium.

artifacts.name: commands-seats
artifacts.description: Seat-fact backfill commands — PDC identifier links (#79) and WSL+SOS House Position (#101).

artifacts.name: code-exploration
artifacts.description: Code exploration tool selection — the goal→tool table, the measurements behind the broken file-dependency-graph finding (empty graph_query/_circular/_stats or file-mode impact output means the tool is broken, never 'no dependents'), and the source of the session-start ToolSearch prefetch query.

artifacts.name: api
artifacts.description: The HTTP API — the read-only /api/v1 surface: route inventory, pagination, and the response contracts.

artifacts.name: deployment
artifacts.description: Deployment reference — systemd unit table, the OnFailure alerting chain, the owner/app/test DB role split, the restart and lifecycle table, and the assert-main-checkout gate that keeps the prod checkout on main.

artifacts.name: environment
artifacts.description: Every environment variable the deployment reads, with defaults, including the Power Map sidecar tunables.

artifacts.name: logging
artifacts.description: The JSON log record shape ({timestamp, level, logger, message}, four reserved keys) and why every uvicorn invocation must pass --log-config or journald interleaves plain-text access lines with JSON app records.

artifacts.name: lww-noop-gate
artifacts.description: The local-newer no-op gate — the named pattern behind #102. Read before adding a write_enabled producer descriptor, or when a cohort's outbox volume goes flat-but-nonzero forever.

artifacts.name: skills
artifacts.description: Vendored agent skills — inventory, the submodule and symlink layout under skills/ and .claude/skills/, the refresh procedure, and worktree venv isolation.
